cardEffects:
[Hand] [Main] By paying 2 cost and placing this card as the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your Digimon that's level 5 or has the [Legend-Arms] trait, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks.", until the end of your opponent's turn.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an effect places a digivolution card under this Digimon, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and ＜Reboot＞ (This Digimon also unsuspends in your opponent's unsuspend phase.) until the end of your opponent's turn.

inheritedEffect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would be deleted other than by one of your effects, by trashing 1 card with the [Legend-Arms] trait from this Digimon's digivolution cards, prevent it.
name: RaijiLudomon

rulings.answer: No, you can't.  The activation conditions include paying 2 cost and placing this card as 1 of your [Legend-Arms] trait or 1 of your level 5 Digimon's bottom digivolution card, therefore the effect can't be activated just by paying 2 cost.
rulings.question: Can I use this card's [Main] effect to pay 2 cost even when I don't have any [Legend-Arms] trait or level 5 Digimon?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can.  However, in such cases the "can't attack" effect prevents making the attack.
rulings.question: Can I choose an opponent's Digimon with a "can't attack" effect as the target when I activate this card's [Main] effect?

rulings.answer: At the start of your opponent's main phase, the effects gained from this card's effect are triggered at the same time, and your opponent determines which one activates first.  After effects such as [When Attacking] have activated, and before the counter timing occurs, it is time to activate the effect of the 2nd Digimon that was pending activation. However, since the 1st Digimon is already attacking, the effect ends without an attack made.  As a result, only the Digimon whose effect was activated first can attack.
rulings.question: What happens if this card's [Main] effect activates twice and 2 of my opponent's Digimon gain the "[Start of Your Main Phase] This Digimon attacks" effect?

rulings.answer: A Digimon with a "this Digimon isn't affected by your opponent’s effects" effect can also be chosen as a target for this effect, therefore your opponent's Digimon will lose the "this Digimon isn't affected by your opponent’s effects" effect as soon as it becomes your opponent's turn, then it will be affected by this card's effect.  As a result, the attack occurs at the start of the main phase.
rulings.question: What happens if this card's [Main] effect is activated on an opponent's Digimon with an "[Opponent's Turn] This Digimon isn't affected by your opponent’s effects" effect?
